notes.title: Dino Quake Update Plans & Thanks!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!

[b]Dino Quake has officially launched[/b] and I just wanted to say a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all of you who played it and shared your thoughts![/p][p]We've passed 20 reviews already and your feedback means a lot. If you enjoyed the game and haven't left a review yet please consider doing so: it really helps spread the word and support indie games like this one 🦖
[/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b]
I'm already planning a free content update to bring more action and surprises to Dino Quake. More details soon!
[/p][p]Thanks again for playing and being part of this quake-powered adventure!
Stay tuned, the ground will shake again soon. 💥[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3342430/Dino_Quake/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
